# Cherie (01, engineer) — BAD-022

## Brief
Make a red `smoke` or `test` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml block merging a PR into BadTakes main, without stranding PRs that ci.yml's path filter skips (docs-only, site/, admin/).

Today branch protection requires only the `Gate` check (context "Gate", GitHub Actions app 15368, strict false). gate.yml is a trivial filter-free workflow; ci.yml is filtered by workflow-level `paths-ignore`, so its jobs cannot be required directly. Eric's decision (2026-09-14): `smoke` and `test` (Linux) become blocking; `test-windows` and `warm-ffmpeg` stay advisory.

Design (Spud's call; push back in your result if you find it wrong):
- ci.yml loses its workflow-level `paths-ignore` on both `push` and `pull_request`, so it runs on every PR and every push to main.
- A cheap `changes` job decides whether the diff touches anything outside today's ignore list (keep that list in exactly one place, with today's entries). pull_request: base SHA to head SHA of the PR. push: `github.event.before` to `github.sha`; an all-zero or unreachable `before` means run everything. Any doubt fails toward running the app jobs. Prefer plain git in a run step over a third-party action.
- `test`, `smoke` and `test-windows` get `needs: changes` and `if:` on its output; `warm-ffmpeg` keeps today's behaviour (push only, and only when app paths changed, since the workflow filter used to skip it).
- A new job with `name: Gate` (the exact context branch protection requires) `needs: [changes, test, smoke]`, `if: always()`, and fails when any needed result is `failure` or `cancelled`; `success` and `skipped` pass. A failed `changes` job fails Gate (closed, not open).
- Delete .github/workflows/gate.yml, and move its header's reasoning (why protection requires Gate and not the filtered jobs, and the empty-status trap) into ci.yml's comments, updated for the new shape. Two jobs named Gate must never exist at once.
- Update every comment and doc that says smoke is not required or that Gate lives in gate.yml: ci.yml's smoke comment, TODO.md around line 520, and anything else `git grep -n 'gate.yml\|requires only'` finds in your deliverables.
- No branch-protection or other repository-setting change: the required context stays `Gate`.

Setup: run `bash scripts/worktree-init.sh` first. Read .claude/skills/implementing-changes/SKILL.md for how this repo proves a change.

Verification you run (you cannot push, so the PR's own CI run is Spud's to check):
- Lint the workflow: actionlint if available (`command -v actionlint`, or via podman, never Docker), else parse the YAML with node and review the expressions by hand; say which you did.
- Exercise the change-detection logic locally against real git ranges in this repo: a range that touches only `**/*.md` or site/ must say "skip", a range touching src/ or main.js must say "run", a mixed range must say "run", and a zero `before` must say "run". Put the logic where it can be run this way (a small script under scripts/ is fine if ci.yml calls it; then it is also a deliverable you may create).
- `npm test` stays green.
Report the commands and their output in `member result`.
